messages.subject: Constrained Bifactor Estimation
parts:
October 28, 2019

Hello all,

I am trying to fit a constrained bifactor model in lavaan.  I know how to do this with more complicated constraints, but I would like to do this more simply as discussed in the CALIS manual (where CALIS allows the user to define new parameters to be used in the constraint functions).   Is this possible in lavaan?  The code below does not work because lavaan does not know what a, b, and c are.  Is there a way to define new parameters.  Thanks to all for any and all help.

Best

Niels Waller
University of Minnesota

messages.subject: Re: Constrained Bifactor Estimation
parts:
Niels,
a, b and c appear to be constraining the ratios of G to L for pairs of items within specific factors.  Could you impose the constraints without these added parameters as shown below?  Caveat, you did not provide a runable example, so I have only tested with lavaanify() and not by estimating the model.

Keith

require(lavaan)

mod04_modified = '

# loadings of MVs on LVs in Lambda (L)
    G        =~ G01*X1 + G02*X2 + G03*X3 +
                    G04*X4 + G05*X5 + G06*X6 +
                    G07*X7 + G08*X8 + G09*X9

    F1  =~ L01*X1  + L02*X2  +  L03*X3
    F2  =~ L04*X4  + L05*X5  +  L06*X6
    F3  =~ L07*X7 +  L08*X8 +   L09*X9
   

  # unique factor variances for MVs
    X1  ~~ X1
    X2  ~~ X2  
    X3  ~~ X3
    X4  ~~ X4
    X5  ~~ X5
    X6  ~~ X6
    X7  ~~ X7
    X8  ~~ X8
    X9  ~~ X9
 


  # LV variances and covariances in Psi (P)
    G  ~~ 1*G
    F1 ~~ 1*F1
    F2 ~~ 1*F2  
    F3 ~~ 1*F3

    F1 ~~ 0*G
    F2 ~~ 0*G + 0*F1
    F3 ~~ 0*G + 0*F1 + 0*F2
   
  # constraints
  # This is what I would like to do

#       G01 == a*L01
  #       G02 == a*L02
  #       G03 == a*L03
    G01 == L01 * G02 / L02
    G02 == L02 * G03 / L03  
   
   
  #       G04 == b*L04
  #       G05 == b*L05
  #       G06 == b*L06
    G04 == L04 * G05 / L05
    G05 == L05 * G06 / L06  
   
       
  #       G07 == c*L07
  #       G08 == c*L08
  #       G09 == c*L09
    G07 == L07 * G08 / L08
    G08 == L08 * G09 / L09  
     
 ' # end mod04_modified
 
 lavaanify(mod04_modified)

messages.subject: Re: Constrained Bifactor Estimation

Hi Niels,
It is hard to guess what exactly you need.  However, would an approach like the following serve your needs?

# The Holzinger and Swineford (1939) example
HS.model <- ' visual  =~ l1v * x1 + l2v * 1 * x2 + x3
              textual =~ l4t * x4 + l5t * 1 * x5 + x6
              speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9
             
              # Constructed parameters
              a := l1v / l2v
              b := l4t / l5t
             
              # Constraint
              a == b
            ' # end HS.model

             
 lavaanify(HS.model)            
             
             
fit <- lavaan(HS.model, data=HolzingerSwineford1939,
              auto.var=TRUE, auto.fix.first=FALSE,
              auto.cov.lv.x=TRUE)
summary(fit, fit.measures=TRUE)



Keith

messages.author: 6529a560d4ca5b94
messages.subject: Re: Constrained Bifactor Estimation
parts:
It looks to me like you are wanting to fit a bifactor model with testlet constraints. I've not done that in lavaan before, but I imagine that the strategy I use to fit such models in Mplus will work fine:

(1) Give loadings for the same item the same label in both the general and specific factor
(2) Assign a variance of 1 to the general factor
(3) Allow the specific factor variances to be freely estimated

This is how testlet IRT models were parameterized to facilitate their estimation before the dimensionality reduction trick was discovered.

-David
